responses: Water {crop} when the top 2-3 cm of soil feels dry, preferably early in the morning to cut evaporation. Drip irrigation can save 30-50% water compared to flood irrigation.
For most field crops: irrigate early morning, keep the root zone moist but not waterlogged, and mulch to retain moisture. Drip systems are the most water-efficient option.
